# What the two Detail sliders mean, on both hosts.
#
# `Amounts::for_editor` in native/rawshim/src/galosh_srgb.rs and `denoiseAmounts` in
# web/src/features/raw_edit/gpu/shaders.ts are the same curve written twice, and the editor's live
# preview takes one while an export takes the other - so the two disagreeing is a picture that
# changes when it is saved. Each was pinned only against its own host at 0, 40, 50 and 100, which
# a rewrite landing on those four and missing everywhere between would pass.
#
# Off-landmark on purpose, and the halves of the colour track are both represented: `blend` is the
# first half and saturates at the middle, `ridge` is flat until the middle and opens after it.
#
# luminance colour  luma blend ridge
0    0      0.00  0.00  1.00
10   10     0.20  0.20  1.00
25   25     0.50  0.50  1.00
37   63     0.74  1.00  1.52
50   50     1.00  1.00  1.00
63   37     1.26  0.74  1.00
75   75     1.50  1.00  2.00
88   88     1.76  1.00  2.52
100  100    2.00  1.00  3.00
100  0      2.00  0.00  1.00
0    100    0.00  1.00  3.00
